modified_sections.description: Updated to reference R39 contract and whitespace supported domain. Clarified that multi-file publication does not provide transactional atomicity or crash durability on ANY volume regardless of volume journaling. Described explicit bounded whitespace support profile W and capability boundary NONBLANK check.
Added SUPPORTED_WHITESPACE_CHARS (set W of 18 code points), ASCII_WHITESPACE_CHARS (6 code points), and LEGACY_VERSION_SENSITIVE_WS ({'\u180e'}).

Removed Python isspace() from semantic blank decision. Reject empty strings and all-W strings; version-sensitive blank-only strings involving U+180E are explicitly unsupported; interior Unicode and boundary Omega preserved verbatim.

Scans entire leading and trailing boundary whitespace regions using set W and U+180E. Rejects non-ASCII whitespace and U+180E fail-closed. Trims supported ASCII whitespace only. Retains original Unicode interior and boundary non-whitespace characters (like Omega).
Replaced p.isspace() with all(c in (SUPPORTED_WHITESPACE_CHARS | LEGACY_VERSION_SENSITIVE_WS) for c in p) to remove isspace() dependence.
Saved structural_ascii_strip result for expectedCapabilityBoundary and added explicit check: if len(stripped_cap) == 0: raise ValueError(...) BEFORE raw binding/outputs.
Updated docstring and manifest guarantees_and_limits to explicitly state multi_file_transactional_atomicity_unsupported: True and crash_durability_unproven: True.
